quote: One day as I was sitting alone in my study surrounded by books on all kinds of subjects, devoting myself to literary studies, my usual habit, my mind dwelt at length on the weighty opinions of various authors whom I had studied for a long time.
source: Christine de Pizan, The Book of the City of Ladies, Part One, ch. 1, the opening sentence (trans. Earl Jeffrey Richards, 1982)
note: Corrected: the proposal stopped after subjects and closed a dependent clause with a full stop the edition does not have. The whole opening sentence is restored here from a scan of the Persea 1982 Richards translation, chapter 1. No page is claimed. The sentence sets a scene rather than offering counsel, which the editor should weigh.
